productStatement.framework: MBB v0.5.3 §7.2 + CityMETER Product Brief v6 §1.6 (Who → What → Which → How)

job: ถ้าจะเปิดร้านที่นี่ จะอยู่ข้างใคร — อ่านเมืองผ่านย่านในภาพ 3 มิติทันที แล้วเจาะลงถึงศูนย์การค้า อาคาร และสาขาพร้อมหลักฐาน
audiences: ทีมขยายสาขาและ distributor ของแบรนด์หรู
ทีม leasing / asset ของศูนย์การค้า
นักวิเคราะห์และที่ปรึกษาด้านทำเล
journey: เห็นข้อค้นพบระดับย่านและเมือง 3 มิติที่โฟกัส 3 ย่านอันดับต้นแล้วทันที ไม่ต้องตั้งค่าตัวกรอง; ซูมออกทั้งประเทศแล้วยังเห็นกรอบจังหวัดที่มีแบรนด์ กดเพื่อเจาะลง
ขยายเป็นทุกย่านด้วยการกดครั้งเดียว (ดูทุกย่าน) หรือเจาะย่านจาก breadcrumb/ป้าย
เปิดโปรไฟล์ย่าน: บุคลิกตามกลุ่มแบรนด์ สถานที่ แบรนด์เฉพาะ/ร่วม ในมุมมองโมเดลเมือง (เส้นตั้งตั้งตรง)

เจาะสถานที่: เฉพาะอาคารและร้านของสถานที่นั้นมีสี อาคารของสถานที่มองเห็นเสมอ (x-ray) และกดได้ กล้องมุมสถาปนิก (2-point) จัดกรอบทั้งอาคารรวมหลังคา อาคารรอบข้างจางลงและอาคารที่บังโปร่งใส; เจาะร้าน อ่านสถานะ หลักฐาน และระดับความแม่นของพิกัด
เปรียบเทียบย่านด้วยกราฟและตารางช่องเท่ากัน แล้วคัดรายการไปสำรวจ

rowScopes.visibleCue: chart scope caption appends ‘ทุกย่าน’ whenever rows ≠ scopeRows; counters are labelled ‘ในโฟกัส’ when focus narrows rows

firstAha.ranking: top three fixed neighborhoods by distinct brand labels, POS count, stable ID
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {sharePercent}% ของแบรนด์อยู่ใน {areaCount} ย่านนี้

mapFocusContract.principle: Show detail only for the focused part; keep everything else quiet (owner instruction 2026-10-22)

overviewAuto.focus: top-3 areas: count fill, labels with counts, category pins, host buildings, rounded focus massing (zoom ≥ 13)
overviewAuto.quiet: other areas outline-only with quiet labels; rows outside focus are grey context dots without logos; city massing in the quiet tone; no logos below zoom 14

overviewAll.focus: all defined areas filled by distinct brands (count family, 5 equal-interval classes), labels with counts
overviewAll.quiet: pins are size-tiered dots; city massing only; no rounded focus massing

neighborhood.focus: selected area fill below zoom 14.5, selected outline, host buildings, rounded focus massing, category pins, logos

store.focus: selected pin ring, leader line to the source coordinate, desktop popup; a store inside a venue inherits the venue state

venue.focus: only the venue's own rows: category pins, logos, host building(s) in map.activeLayer drawn by the venue x-ray on top of every massing tier (always visible, clickable via the style layer); camera = eye preset framed on the host footprint(s) and roof
venue.quiet: other venues' rows are grey context dots; their host buildings are not drawn as data and fall back to quiet/focus massing; SCENE.eye lowers massing opacity (city 0.16, focus 0.62) and buildings between the camera and the venue move to the 0.14-opacity occluder layer; the city tier also fades to the ground tone with distance from the focus

countryAll.focus: below zoom 9: province frames filled by distinct brands per province (count family, 5 equal-interval classes of their own), ink-chip province labels with counts, legend “จังหวัด · จำนวนแบรนด์”, panel list “จังหวัดที่มีแบรนด์”
countryAll.quiet: provinces without rows in the dataset are not drawn (out_of_scope); with a จังหวัด filter the other frames are outline-only (quiet); from zoom 9 the frames are outlines until zoom 12 and the neighborhoods carry the scale

choropleth.metric: distinct brand labels per defined neighborhood within scopeRows
choropleth.classification: equal-interval, 5 classes from the current maximum, integer closed intervals shown in the legend
choropleth.themePolicy: identical light HEX on both themes; fill-opacity 1 inserted before the basemap's first line layer (waterway); hard switch off at zoom ≥ 14.5

mapFocusContract.hostBuildings: map.activeLayer role (light #347DA8 / dark #65B6DB), only for rows in focus, extrusion zoom ≥ 14, outline zoom ≥ 12, visible in both plan and 3D
mapFocusContract.logos: zoom ≥ 14, rows in focus only, ≤ 250 (js/pins.js LOGO_MIN_ZOOM, MAX_LOGOS)
mapFocusContract.detailRows: js/app.js#detailRows: venueLevel() ? rows of the current venue (mallId, else venue label) : rows
mapFocusContract.areaLabels: ink chips (--area-label-bg/ink/border, display font, area square glyph, light count badge) so they never read as brand logo boxes; quiet = 72% opacity; hidden below zoom 11.5
mapFocusContract.drawOrder: host extrusion (buildings.js) is installed first; installMassing({beforeId: HOST_LAYERS.extrusion}) inserts city/focus/occluder tiers before it; venue-xray is the last 3D layer (before water-name). Reason: MapLibre 3D layers share one depth buffer and translucent fill-extrusion writes depth in its first pass, so anything drawn later and farther is cut away.

basemapContract.generator: js/map-style.js#buildMapStyle(theme, {palette, tileJSON, glyphs}) — a MapLibre style v8 object built at runtime; no hosted style URL

tiles.buildingLayer: building (fields render_height, render_min_height, hide_3d; available z13–14)
tiles.labels: name:th preferred, then name; no POI, housenumber or boundary labels

palette.source: assets/theme.css --basemap-* tokens (light and dark declared once each; basemap-only, not data colours)

layerOrder: massing + host buildings (inserted before MASSING_BEFORE = water-name, the first symbol layer)
area outlines, selection outline, pins, logos
basemapContract.atmosphere: sky + fog blend the far ground into the paper colour; viewport-anchored light (#FFFFFF, intensity 0.32) gives massing a soft shade; both are quiet context, never data
basemapContract.themeSwitch: map.setStyle(buildMapStyle(theme)) then re-install spatial layers; data layers keep the same HEX on both themes

massingContract.module: js/massing.js#installMassing(map, {sourceId, beforeId, colors, tileUrl, fetchImpl}) → {update, retheme, dispose, layerIds}

cityTier.layer: city-massing (fill-extrusion, source openmaptiles, source-layer building, minzoom 13)
cityTier.height: render_height / render_min_height from the tile; hide_3d features excluded
cityTier.filter: ['all', ['!=', ['get','hide_3d'], true], ['!', ['in', ['id'], ['literal', hiddenIds]]]] — OSM twins of host buildings hidden by feature id

focusTier.source: focus-massing (GeoJSON built from the same tile URLs MapLibre loads, decoded by js/mvt.js; z14, ≤ 9 tiles per update, tiles touching the focus regions only)
focusTier.selection: buildings overlapping a focus polygon (point-in-ring or ring intersection), clipped to the tile box with buffer, host-overlapping buildings dropped
focusTier.shape: js/geometry.js: cleanRing → clipRingToBox → offsetRing(+d) → roundRing(r, 3 segments, encloseOffset d)
focusTier.visibility: 3D and plan (plan shows the rounded footprints flat)
focusTier.cacheKey: regions + hosts + zoom bucket (full zoom level) + tile availability

hostTier.visibility: extrusion zoom ≥ 14, outline zoom ≥ 12, rows in focus only; before MASSING_BEFORE

rounding.radiusMetres: roundingRadiusM(zoom, lat) = clamp(4 px in metres at max(zoom, 14.5), 3, 12)
rounding.reference: maplibre/maplibre-style-spec#1047 (polygon corner radius) is unsupported in MapLibre; rounding is done in geometry, display only

enclosure.radiusCap: radius ≤ 0.95 · d / (1 − sin(θ/2)) so the rounded ring still encloses the original polygon at every corner
enclosure.purpose: the quiet city twin stays fully inside the rounded focus solid → no z-fighting without hiding it; host twins are hidden instead because the host solid is the data layer

massingContract.provenance: building heights and footprints are OSM via OpenFreeMap (defaults when no height tag); context only, never a claim of this dataset; OpenFreeMap merges same-height buildings into MultiPolygons, so single roofs cannot be picked

scene.occluderLayer: focus-massing-occluding (same source as the focus tier; filter by unique feature ids; the focus tier excludes them)
scene.occlusionTest: screen-space: a focus building whose box (ground vertices + tops lifted by height × local px/m × sin(pitch)) overlaps a target's box and whose mean ground y is larger (nearer the camera) is an occluder; recomputed on moveend and after each tile update; targets = the venue's host rings (buildings.js displayedFeatures filtered by mall_ids / venue_names) with display_height_m

distanceFade.rule: city-tier colour interpolates from --basemap-massing-quiet (fade 0) to --basemap-ground (fade 1, invisible) by distance from the nearest focus anchor (area centroid; every area when nothing is focused)
distanceFade.mechanism: feature-state `fade` written once per building id after tiles load (querySourceFeatures on sourcedata/moveend); anchors change → states rebuilt
distanceFade.why: MapLibre has no camera-distance expression and fill-extrusion-opacity is not data-driven

cameraContract.module: js/camera.js (CAMERA, presetFor, applyPreset, fitPitched, framePoint, shiftPadding)

plan.when: view3d off (3D toggle / ?view3d=0) or bounds wider than 0.3°

model.when: neighborhood in 3D (and venue level when มุมสถาปนิก is switched off) — near-axonometric, verticals upright

eye.when: venue level only (venue mode, or a store inside a venue): on by default, ?cam=model opts out; disabled elsewhere and in 2D; on mobile portrait it waits until the sheet closes
eye.constraint: MapLibre 5.6.2 draws fill-extrusion displaced or not at all once the horizon enters the viewport (pitch > 90 − fov/2) — verified live 2026-10-22 (pitch 73 ok, 76 displaced, 82 missing); the eye preset keeps the horizon just outside the frame (90 − 12 − 3 = 75)

fitting.function: fitPitched(map, bounds, {preset, padding, maxZoom 16, minZoom 10, points, shift})
fitting.method: start from cameraForBounds (flat), apply preset pitch/bearing/FOV, zoom out in 0.1 steps until every point (polygon vertices when given, else bbox corners) projects inside the padded viewport, then zoom in while they still fit; jumps are computed without rendering and the final camera is animated
fitting.padding: desktop 3D padding ignores the legend; mobile portrait with the sheet open uses plan, then re-frames in 3D on sheet close
fitting.bearing: 28° so the Siam → Chit Lom → Phrom Phong axis runs left-to-right on wide screens
fitting.venue: frameVenue: fitPitched over the host footprint vertices AND roof vertices (vertex + display_height_m, projected with camera.projectPoint through transform.modelViewProjectionMatrix), top padding 12% (eye) / 10% (model), maxZoom 17.6, minZoom = max(14.5, footprint-only fit − 1) so a very tall tower cannot push the pins out of reading range; falls back to framePoint(zoom 16) when no host building is displayed or on mobile portrait
fitting.neighborhood: fitArea: fitPitched over the area outline vertices, maxZoom 17.5 so the outline fills the frame

maplibre.requires: setVerticalFieldOfView (≥ 4.7), maxPitch 85; keep pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3 for any fill-extrusion view
maplibre.orthographic: not available in MapLibre; narrow FOV is the standard substitute

cameraContract.alternatives: deck.gl custom projectionMatrix or three.js camera.setViewOffset give a true two-point camera; not adopted to keep a single MapLibre scene

levels: จังหวัด (ชื่อไทย; code in URL)
ย่าน (dataset-specific neighborhood core; from point-in-polygon on the venue's representative point when a venue is open)
สถานที่ (venue: CityMETER Shopping Center id, else plain venue label)

productionPath.proposal: /v3/citymeter/{PROVINCE_CODE}/N/{neighborhood id}/V/{center id}?d=luxuryBrands until the cores are registered as Locales (then /L/{locale uuid}/V/{center id})
productionPath.status: Inference — proposal, not implemented in production

breadcrumbContract.demoQuery: ?province=BKK&neighborhood=siam&place=<center id> (code preferred; Thai/English province names from older links still resolve)

provinceCodes.BKK: กรุงเทพมหานคร
provinceCodes.SPK: สมุทรปราการ
provinceCodes.NMA: นครราชสีมา

breadcrumbContract.dataBinding: data/neighborhoods.geojson properties.provinceCode / provinceName (nimman = CMI, others BKK)
actions: crumb-venue (re-open the venue profile by id or label)
crumb-expand (unfold collapsed levels on narrow screens)

a store is never a crumb — the panel heading names it; the crumb trail ends at its venue (or ย่าน for street stores)
four or more levels fold the upper ones behind “…” on narrow screens (crumb-expand); the last two stay visible
venue ids come from data/luxury.json centers[].id (source: landometer.com/api/v2/citymeter-v3/shopping-center/detail/{id}, externalId SC-…)

panel.navigation: back stack (max 20); mode and id restored from URL (?province, ?neighborhood, ?place, ?store, ?areas, ?view3d, ?cam)

models.neighborhood: js/profile-model.js#buildNeighborhoodProfile (uses scopeRows so exclusive/shared keeps the whole selection as reference)

panel.renderer: js/panel.js (pure HTML strings, delegated data-action clicks); breadcrumb rendered first in .panel-top

data.observationGrain: one declared brand store/counter/POS observation; repeated source records are not silently merged
data.cityMassing: OpenFreeMap vector tiles, building source-layer (context, not part of the dataset)
data.closurePolicy: Retain permanently closed records and factual closure status; exclude from the default current view; never delete to improve counts
data.coordinatePolicy: Preserve original geographic coordinates; marker displacement is screen-space only; precision is described from geometryRole/geometryStatus and never upgraded
data.provinces: data/provinces.geojson (metadata.version 2026-10-22-r1; OpenGISData-Thailand CC BY 4.0; context frames)

visualSystem.appliedTokens: assets/theme.css (foundation pairs, semantic states, map roles, data states, series 1–10, count classes, basemap-only tokens)

locationProfile.reason: profile defines business metrics (demand, supply, market size …) that this dataset does not carry

icons.fallback: visible semantic text label (3D / มุมสถาปนิก toggles use text)

toolbar: มุมสถาปนิก

invariants.rule: One store observation owns one pin; no clustering or aggregation, including quiet context pins
250 logo labels is a ceiling, never a quota; logos only at zoom ≥ 14 and only for rows in focus
Preserve original logo artwork; use the verified local sprite and restrained framing
Default first insight concerns neighborhoods, not venues; venues are the fallback only when no defined area has rows
Never sum distinct brands across areas; use set union
Keep generic caveats and workflow notes out of UI; retain provenance in documentation and real closure/error states
No CSV download UI
No decorative bracket or colored left rail; keep visible focus
No fabricated coordinates, store openings, administrative boundaries or consumer behavior claims
Pins, counters, table and panel counts use the same committed rows; Aha, choropleth and charts use scopeRows and say so when they differ
Detail only for the focused part; everything else stays visible but quiet (no logos, grey dots, outline-only areas, quiet massing)
Analytical colours keep the approved light HEX on both themes; contrast is solved with labels, outlines and backplates, never by recolouring data
Exclusive/shared and the Aha denominator reference the whole filtered scope, never a single selected area
The first view is 3D with the top-3 areas focused; ?areas=all and the 3D toggle are the only ways to leave that state, and neither changes the data
Basemap and massing colours come only from --basemap-* tokens; they never reuse data, series or state colours, and massing never encodes a metric
City massing is OSM context: rounding and enclosure are display-only, heights are never quoted as dataset facts, and host buildings stay the only building layer that carries data colour
Breadcrumb levels are ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › ย่าน with production province codes; the demo never invents a Locale or municipality id
Matrix cells are equal in size; only the number and its count class carry meaning
Camera presets never move or scale data; the eye preset is the venue-level camera only (default there, ?cam=model opts out) and never applies to overview or neighborhood

At venue level only the venue's rows carry detail: its host building is the only blue one; other venues' buildings and pins become quiet context; the eye scene only changes massing opacity, never data

On-screen copy is short and natural, without caveats: แบรนด์ = distinct brand labels, สาขา = one point-of-sale record, สถานที่ = venue; provenance, units and limits live in the data section, help and docs
The venue's host building is never hidden by context: it is drawn before every massing tier and the venue x-ray draws it on top in 3D; its click target is the style layer
Province frames are navigation context with their own count classes; they never replace the neighborhood scale above zoom 9 and never claim administrative authority
Pictograms are decorative: every tile and heading keeps its text label; the nav-7 approved subset stays byte-identical and the pictogram subset is a declared test exception

chartContracts.title: ย่านที่มีแบรนด์
chartContracts.question: ย่านใดมีแบรนด์หลากหลาย
chartContracts.encoding: horizontal bars; bar fill = count class of the area
chartContracts.metric: distinct brand labels per assigned neighborhood

chartContracts.encoding: numeric heat table with table-layout fixed and a <colgroup>; every cell equal width/height; cell tint = count class of the cell value; 0 shown with zero outline; caption states cell size carries no meaning
chartContracts.metric: distinct brand labels per neighborhood × segment

chartContracts.title: แบรนด์เฉพาะ / ร่วม
chartContracts.question: แต่ละย่านมีแบรนด์ต่างหรือซ้ำกับย่านอื่นเพียงใด
chartContracts.encoding: stacked horizontal bars with shape cues
chartContracts.metric: brands assigned to exactly one versus multiple neighborhoods
chartContracts.reference: all assigned neighborhoods in scopeRows, before display truncation

delivery.devHook: window.__citymeter (state, map, update, fitMap, fitPitched, applyPreset, buildMapStyle) — console tuning only, not an API

venueXrayContract.module: js/venue-xray.js#installVenueXray(map, {beforeId, toMercator, colors}) → {update(features, {colors}), setEnabled, dispose, count, enabled, failed}
venueXrayContract.layer: venue-xray (type custom, renderingMode 3d), inserted before water-name after every fill-extrusion layer
venueXrayContract.input: host features of the venue being looked at (mall_ids / venue_names match) with render_as = extrusion; display_base_m / display_height_m
venueXrayContract.geometry: walls (two triangles per edge), roof via earcut (holes supported; js/vendor/earcut.js 3.2.4 ISC), edge lines; mercator coordinates relative to the centroid origin; z = MercatorCoordinate.z of the altitude
venueXrayContract.matrix: options.defaultProjectionData.mainMatrix (64-bit) × translate(origin) multiplied on the CPU, Float32 to the shader
venueXrayContract.depth: scissored depth clear inside the venue screen box (device pixels, padded 4 px), then LEQUAL read-write depth test against itself only; polygon offset keeps edges on top
venueXrayContract.visibility: 3D only (pitch > 0) and zoom ≥ 13 (XRAY_MIN_ZOOM); hidden with the 3D toggle; disabled at non-venue levels (empty feature set)
venueXrayContract.colours: faces map.activeLayer × shade (roof 1, walls 0.66–0.92 by orientation), edges map.selectedStroke — map roles, not data colours
venueXrayContract.interaction: click/hover remain on luxury-venue-buildings-3d; MapLibre fill-extrusion hit-testing ignores what was drawn over it
venueXrayContract.failSafe: a GL error disables the layer (failed = true) and the style host layer keeps drawing
references: MapLibre src/render/draw_fill_extrusion.ts — translucent extrusions drawn depth-first, then colour with depth EQUAL
venueXrayContract.knownTradeOff: inside the cleared box a translucent 2D layer that sits below an opaque fill in style order may draw over it; none of the generated paper style layers are ordered that way

provinceContract.data: data/provinces.geojson — 9 provinces present in the dataset; id = production code (BKK …), properties.dopaCode = DOPA two-digit code, name (Thai), nameEn; metadata: source, sourceCommit, sourceSha256, retrievedOn, license CC BY 4.0, attribution
provinceContract.source: https://github.com/chingchai/OpenGISData-Thailand provinces.geojson (publisher credits DOPA); extracted by scripts/extract-provinces.mjs; coordinates rounded to 5 decimals, no simplification
provinceContract.module: js/provinces.js#installProvinceLayers(map, geojson, {onSelect}) → {update({rows, selectedCode, visible}), retheme, dispose, model}; buildProvinceModel(rows, geojson)
provinceContract.rows: filterRows(data.rows, {...filters, province: ""}) — every filter except the province filter, so each frame keeps its own count
provinceContract.metric: distinct brand labels per province; equal-interval 5 classes of the count family from the province maximum; measured_zero = lowest fill + zero outline; out_of_scope = not drawn

zoomWindows.legend: province classes below 9, neighborhood classes from 9
